metadata.title: Gonzalo Plaza Rueda | Software Engineer
metadata.description: Software Engineer specialized in frontend development (React, Next.js, TypeScript) in Málaga, Spain. I build fast, accessible and scalable web and ecommerce applications.

main.imageAlt: Portrait of Gonzalo Plaza Rueda, Software Engineer in Málaga, Spain
main.description: I'm a Software Engineer with over {devYears} years of experience specialized in frontend development in Málaga, Spain. I've worked on Ecommerce projects and web applications, focused on building fast, accessible and scalable interfaces.

leovegas.subtitle: JavaScript Engineer
leovegas.description: Frontend development for LeoVegas and the group's different brands, within the Gaming Experience squad. Focused on improving the user experience of the Gaming Experience, with attention to performance and observability.

iskaypet.subtitle: Software Engineer
iskaypet.description: Frontend development (with a bit of backend 🤭) on web and ecommerce applications for the group's brands. I led the definition of a new digital product and took part in omnichannel initiatives aimed at improving sales profitability. I drove frontend observability and shared that knowledge through internal workshops, as well as contributing to the team's best-practice guidelines.

lolaDiazBebes.subtitle: Web Developer
lolaDiazBebes.description: Production launch of the company's first ecommerce, taking part from the initial idea through to deployment. Definition of guidelines for SEO, performance and best practices for the maintenance and evolution of the project.

hermanosBravo.subtitle: IT Technician and Sales Associate
hermanosBravo.description: Repairs and technical support for electronic devices and computers. Increased sales through specialized advice and optimization of customer service processes to deliver a professional and personalized service.

todoOcio.subtitle: IT Technician and Sales Associate
todoOcio.description: Management of repairs and technical support for computers and mobile devices. Improved customer satisfaction and optimization of service and sales processes for an efficient and professional experience.

garajePlus.title: GarajePlus
garajePlus.description: A project designed to make vehicle maintenance tracking easier. The goal is to keep a complete history of every maintenance, repair and inspection for any vehicle.

colorQuery.title: ColorQuery
colorQuery.description: A web tool to identify a color's name from its hexadecimal value. It also suggests the closest color when no exact name exists, making color selection and reference easier in web and graphic design.
colorQuery.imageAlt: ColorQuery interface showing color selection and names from hexadecimal values

medacDent.title: MedacDent
medacDent.description: A web application for managing appointments at a dental clinic. A practice project focused on development with vanilla JavaScript and SASS, optimizing the user experience and data organization.
